user_story: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve a task by a valid ID
steps: Send a request to the task retrieval endpoint with a valid task ID.
Receive the response from the server.
positive.expected_result: The response contains the full details of the task associated with the provided ID.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with an invalid ID
steps: Send a request to the task retrieval endpoint with an invalid task ID.
Receive the response from the server.
negative.expected_result: The response indicates an error, such as 'Task not found' or similar status code.

edge.title: Retrieve a task by an ID that is a boundary case (e.g., zero or negative ID)
steps: Send a request to the task retrieval endpoint with an ID of 0 or a negative number.
Receive the response from the server.
edge.expected_result: The response indicates an error or a specific message indicating that the ID is not valid.
